title: First Maximum Radius
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the radius for the first maximum as 0.1 m.

title: Second Minimum Radius
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the radius for the second minimum as 0.2 m.

title: Maxima and Minima Positions
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide correct positions for the maxima and minima along the axis.

title: Use of Fresnel Zones
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of the Fresnel zone concept and its application.

title: Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common calculation mistakes, such as incorrect application of the Fresnel zone formula.
